about.title: Discover Cambodia with confidence and ease.
about.subtitle: We help travelers explore memorable destinations through thoughtful guidance, local insights, and practical travel tools.
about.missionText: To make tourism more welcoming, informed, and rewarding by connecting visitors with curated places, cultural stories, and reliable planning support.

values.title: Curated discovery
values.text: Every destination is selected to offer meaningful experiences and lasting memories.

values.title: Local connection
values.text: We highlight communities, traditions, and culture so travel feels authentic and respectful.

values.title: Sustainable travel
values.text: We encourage experiences that support nature, heritage, and long-term community wellbeing.

faqs.q: How does Smart Tourism help my travel in Cambodia?
faqs.a: We provide curated destination recommendations, cultural guidelines, interactive maps, and 24/7 support to make your trip effortless.

faqs.q: Can I contact local guides directly through this platform?
faqs.a: Yes! We connect you with verified local guides and authentic experiences across all major provinces.

faqs.q: Is the platform free to use for travelers?
faqs.a: Exploring destinations, guides, and itineraries on Smart Tourism is 100% free.

about.contactSubtitle: Connect with our team directly for custom itineraries or instant travel assistance.
